pwd && echo "---GITLOG---" && git log --oneline -8 && echo "---STATUS---" && git status --short
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3330 2>/dev/null; echo " <- :3330"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3210 2>/dev/null; echo " <- :3210"
agent-browser open http://localhost:3330/ 2>&1 | tail -3 && agent-browser eval "localStorage.removeItem('habit-tracker-ui'); location.reload(); 'cleared'" 2>&1 | tail -2

agent-browser click @e4 2>&1 | tail -2

agent-browser eval "({hasDarkAfterReload: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark'), stored: (JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('habit-tracker-ui')||'{}').state||{}).theme, bg: getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor})" 2>&1 | tail -6
